cleansingStrength.rationale: strong by C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate @2 (ether type) reinforced by prominent Sodium Laureth-8 Sulfate @4 (C3b: strong anionic, ether type); buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @5. C3b limit: read as a buffer the laureth-8 sulfate would give moderate, so confidence at most moderate, neighbor moderate. Later ether sulfates (@13, @14, @15, @19) are after the E3 point and recorded only.

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led; the only substantive conditioner is Polyquaternium-10 @21 after the E3 point; PEG-3 Distearate @6 pearlizer adds little slip; no silicone or lipid. Counter-signal: a cationic polymer is present; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: low: one late cationic polymer (Polyquaternium-10 @21) is the only deposition family and faces a strong reset; no silicone, lipid, protein or film former. W2 does not apply (one family).
